$description: Machine-read policy behind PageSpec mode 'generation'. Enforced by the six GENERATION_MODE_* rules in compatibility/graph.json (implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py): BRAND, INTEGRATION_LOGO, PERSON, SCREENSHOT, COPY, URL. In mode 'generation' a PageSpec must be original: only assets whose role is availability generation-safe (pinned in code), no Operate branding, no third-party marks, no real or source-demo people, no source-specific copy, and no real or live URLs/endpoints. Every blocked term and host below was taken from the real clone source and carries an evidence citation (path:line, relative to the source project) that extraction/verify_all.py re-reads to confirm the term is on that line. Detection is string-based: text is normalised (NFKC, zero-width and soft-hyphen characters removed, curly quotes/primes and Unicode dashes mapped to ASCII, case folded, punctuation collapsed) before matching. It does not detect homoglyph substitution from other scripts, images, paraphrase or translation. No human has reviewed these patterns.

modes.clone: Reference reconstruction of the Operate site. May use clone-only and blocked-for-generation assets and the source copy. Never publish.
modes.generation: Original page for any other property. Only generation-safe asset roles, fictional/original copy, relative paths or reserved-domain URLs.

matchModes.case-insensitive: Matched on word boundaries after case folding.
matchModes.not-lowercase: Matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, but only reported when the matched text is not all lower case, so the English verb 'operate' stays usable while 'Operate', 'OPERATE' or 'oPerate' are rejected.

operateBrand.$description: Operate's name, legal entity and domain.

thirdPartyMarks.$description: Third-party trademarks the source shows as integration logos, product names or social labels.

people.$description: People named by the source: the demo avatar art (file names), the demo's named contacts and the owner avatar's alt text (a real person's name).

sourceDemoEntities.$description: Fictional companies that are specific to the source's product demo copy.

sourceHandles.$description: Operate's social profile handles (the path part of its live profile URLs).

blockedHosts.$description: Real hosts the source links to or streams from. Any other non-reserved host is rejected too (urls below); these are listed so the error names the source.

urls.$description: Any absolute URL, protocol-relative URL, www. host, bare domain or e-mail address in generated text must use one of these reserved hosts. Relative paths such as /sign-up are fine.
urls.$allowedHostsNote: Subdomains of an allowed host (www.example.com) are allowed; example.com.evil.io is not.

copyReuse.$description: Any generated string that contains (or is contained in) a source string of at least minWords words is source-specific copy and is rejected. The corpus is derived at run time from the section exemplars, the clone example PageSpec and the template heads, so it cannot drift from the source copy. allowedCopy lists framework-stock text that is generic, not Operate's.
allowedCopy: This page could not be found.
404: This page could not be found.
